$schema.description: Path or URL of teletronix.schema.json, for checking and autocomplete in editors

name.description: The program's name, shown as the page title

start.description: The first screen (default: the first one)

reveal.description: How text appears on every screen, unless a screen or element says otherwise (default: "teletype")

oneOf.description: Types the text one character at a time

duration.description: Milliseconds for the text to resolve (default: config.defaults.glitch)

oneOf.description: Resolves the text out of random glyphs, left to right
Shows the text all at once

transition.description: How screens leave, unless the next screen says otherwise (default: "none")

oneOf.description: The old screen disappears at once

duration.description: Milliseconds for the old screen to erase (default: config.defaults.glitch)

oneOf.description: The old screen erases itself over the new one as it appears
The old screen fades out behind the new one, like phosphor afterglow
A brief burst of full-screen noise, like changing channels, before the new screen

glitch.description: Default glitch options, for reveals and transitions

defaults.description: Default options for each kind of reveal

additionalProperties.description: true or false, a number, or text

variables.description: The program's variables and their starting values: true or false, a number, or text. Actions change them with `set`, toggles, sliders and prompts can be bound to them, `if` tests them, and text shows them as "{name}". They reset when the page reloads.

alert.description: Color of text with the "alert" class (default: "#ff3c00")

anyOf.description: Your own colors

theme.description: The color scheme: "default" (pale blue on black), "amber", "green" or "white", or your own colors (default: "default")

font.description: The typeface, from a set of period PC fonts (default: "ast-premiumexec")

opacity.description: Strength of the lines, from 0 to 1 (default: 0.5)

moving.description: Roll a bright line down the screen (default: true)

anyOf.description: CRT scanlines, with an optional rolling band. On by default.

opacity.description: Strength of the noise, from 0 to 1 (default: 0.15)

scale.description: Size of a noise pixel, in screen pixels (default: 3)

anyOf.description: Analog TV noise over the screen. Off by default.

bloom.description: Glow around bright things (off by default)

radius.description: How far the glow spreads, in pixels (default: 8)

anyOf.description: Bright text and images glow into the dark around them. Off by default.
Darkened corners, like the edge of a curved tube. Off by default.

flicker.description: An unsteady, dimming picture (off by default)

anyOf.description: An unsteady picture that dims by small, irregular amounts. Off by default.

fringe.description: Red and cyan color fringes on text (off by default)

offset.description: How far the colors split, in pixels (default: 1)

anyOf.description: Red and cyan fringes on text, like misaligned color guns. Off by default.

effects.description: Visual effects: true, false, or an object of options

typing.description: Key clicks as text types in (default: true)

glitch.description: Digital crackle during glitch reveals and transitions (default: true)

static.description: Hiss under static, and the static transition (default: true)

interface.description: Beeps for links, toggles, sliders, prompts and dialogs (default: true)

hum.description: A CRT's mains hum and high-pitched whine, all the time (default: false)

key.description: Key click: Each character typed, and keys pressed in a prompt

glitch.description: Glitch: Glitch reveals and the glitch transition

hiss.description: Static hiss: Under the static effect, as loud as the static is strong

select.description: Select: Links, toggles, dialog buttons, known commands

tick.description: Slider tick: A slider moving a step

alert.description: Alert: A dialog with the "alert" class opening

error.description: Error: A command the prompt doesn't know

hum.description: CRT hum: Mains hum and flyback whine, all the time (when turned on)

voices.description: Adjustments to Teletronix's own sounds, overriding their defaults. Tune them by ear on the sound test page (?sound, Built-in tab) and paste the result here.

anyOf.description: Sound options: the volume, and each kind of sound on or off

sound.description: Generated retro sound effects: true, false, or an object of options. On by default; players can mute them with the sound toggle.

blockContextMenu.description: Block the browser's right-click menu, so the program feels like a terminal rather than a web page. Text fields keep theirs (default: true)

autoscroll.description: Scroll to keep new content in view as it appears, unless the reader has scrolled up (default: true)
